## Steady white series captions

- The `series` caption style now sets the whole phrase in steady white type on one translucent charcoal panel per cue. The panel spans both lines of a wrapped cue, so a two-line caption reads as one surface.
- `--accent` no longer colors `series` captions; it still applies to `karaoke` and `pill`. The episode accent remains on the opening badge and code card.
- Both skill copies, the caption guidance, and the `look.py` command hint no longer pass `--accent` for `series` captions.

This release includes both skill variants.
